author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
- Add `history-manager.ts` for managing command history with persistence, search, and analytics.
- Introduce `history-types.ts` to define types and interfaces for history management.
- Create unit tests in `history-manager.test.ts` to validate functionality including adding, searching, clearing, and exporting history.
- Implement localStorage integration for persistent history across sessions.
- Support for command metadata, duplicate handling, and cleanup of old entries.
- Enhance search capabilities with filters for date range, working directory, and success status.

Relates to TASK-029 on #945.
title: feat: implement comprehensive history management for shell commands
